t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I understand that i should use the x1 paying rounds for test in order to understand the game and then use x5 paying round to maximize bonus.

vb_textbox.text: First of all the short gnomes with with yellow, green are given out higher mushrooms so try to pick one of them when it shows x5. The tall gnomes with pink, blue also pays out higher mushrooms. The other ones do not necessarily pay out much mushroom. In any case, just follow your gut feeling as it is sometimes at random. Enjoy!
